question: Which three exact cuisine labels had the highest 2025 Delivered-order GMV in INR? For each label, also give total order count and cancellation rate. Do not split comma-separated cuisine labels.

action.query: SELECT CUISINE AS CUISINE_LABEL, SUM(DELIVERED_SALES_AMOUNT) AS DELIVERED_ORDER_GMV_INR, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ORDER_COUNT, COUNT_IF(IS_CANCELLED) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS CANCELLATION_RATE FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' AND CURRENCY = 'INR' GROUP BY CUISINE ORDER BY DELIVERED_ORDER_GMV_INR DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3
action.metrics: 2025 delivered-order GMV in INR; total order count; cancellation rate = cancelled orders / all orders in each exact cuisine label
action.group_by: CUISINE (exact label; do not split comma-separated labels)

action.answer: For recorded orders dated 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, the three exact cuisine labels with the highest delivered-order GMV in INR were: (1) “North Indian,Chinese” — GMV ₹97,195,380.00; total orders 202,651; cancellation rate 0.058801 (5.880060%). (2) “Indian,Chinese” — GMV ₹60,447,386.00; total orders 126,766; cancellation rate 0.059819 (5.981888%). (3) “Indian” — GMV ₹58,362,786.00; total orders 148,932; cancellation rate 0.060001 (6.000054%). Cancellation rate is cancelled orders divided by all orders for that label. Cuisine labels are kept intact, including comma-separated labels.
